instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Say whether a telemetry sink may send or keep anything about a page or event, from how private the page that was served is", and give it surface; path.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:gate-telemetry-by-privacy and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give surface (site, public-page, elsewhere, app or service) and path of the served page, optionally declared (the privacy class its handler declared) and sink (page_script, page_events, client_health or server_events).
